_odata-v4: Gateway ownership: V4 wire suite belongs beside V2 wire tests.
_rap-serve: Gateway ownership: the RAP R2c wire suite needs the transpiled gateway beside the V2 and V4 wire tests.
_rap-r4: Gateway ownership: the RAP R4 wire suite (ETag, features, numbering) needs the transpiled gateway beside rap-serve.
_rap-r5: Gateway ownership: the RAP R5 wire suite (compositions, projections, navigation writes) needs the transpiled gateway beside rap-r4.
_rap-r6: Gateway ownership: the RAP R6 wire suite (internal, determine and factory actions) needs the transpiled gateway beside rap-r5.
_rap-r7: Gateway ownership: the RAP R7 wire suite (savers, additional and unmanaged save, several pools) needs the transpiled gateway beside rap-r6.
_rap-r8: Gateway ownership: the RAP R8 wire suite (draft over V4) needs the transpiled gateway beside rap-r7.
_rap-r10: Gateway ownership: the RAP R10 wire suite (the flight's draft supplement and agency BOs from packs/rap-flight) needs the transpiled gateway with the pack beside rap-r9.
_rap-r11: Gateway ownership: the RAP R11 wire suite (the flight's agency interface BDEF and carrier singleton from packs/rap-flight) needs the transpiled gateway with the pack beside rap-r10.
_rap-r9: Gateway ownership: the RAP R9 wire suite (draft navigations, owner, Editing Status filters) needs the transpiled gateway beside rap-r8.
_rap-flight-travel: Gateway ownership: RAP R7's flight travel BO served from packs/rap-flight needs the transpiled gateway with the pack beside rap-r7.
